resources.string: Diagnose a plant disease, and see the evidence
Photograph a leaf to identify one of 38 conditions across 14 crops, estimate how far the infection has spread, and view the regions that drove the decision.
Demo model — predictions are not meaningful
This model was exported with --demo, so its classification heads are untrained and every result is effectively random. Train a model and re-export before reading anything into a diagnosis.
Moderate confidence — check the runners-up below before acting.
Low confidence. The model is not separating these classes well on this image; try a sharper, closer, better-lit photo of a single leaf.
Select one to see the heatmap for that class.
No disease detected, so there is no infection severity to report.
Severity labels are derived from colour segmentation, not agronomist annotation. Treat this as an indication, not a measurement.
Shown for completeness only. The current model is untrained, so the diagnosis these steps respond to is not real.
General guidance only. Confirm the diagnosis and any chemical treatment with a local agricultural extension service before applying it — product availability, dosage and regulations vary by region.
Photographs are analysed on this device and never uploaded.
